description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Authentication' for user sign-in and account creation in a preferences UI pane. It manages user interactions for signing in or registering an account and renders related UI elements with associated styling and icons.

classes.name: Props
classes.description: TypeScript type defining properties for the Authentication component, including application and viewControllerManager references.

methods.name: clickSignIn
methods.description: Handles the sign-in button click event by closing preferences and showing the sign-in pane.

methods.name: clickRegister
methods.description: Handles the register button click event by closing preferences and showing the registration pane.
